name: Bedrock / Industrial launcher

request.text: One firing sound of a fictional heavy industrial mining weapon. A brutal compressed mechanical thunk, a short deep pressure blast, and a rattling steel mechanism settling. Dense tactile machinery, substantially different from a normal rifle. Single event immediately at the start, isolated dry close recording. No explosion at a distance, no music, no voice, no repeated shots.
